text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, today is the All Comers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I've been in great shape lately, too.
I wanna win, I wonder if I can...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Too late!!
You're too late, Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
You think so? Seems normal to me, though...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You were slower than Turbo! So Turbo wins
our match to get to the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
I see, the match has already begun, hasn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Turbo's super full of energy today!
So Turbo's definitely gonna win the race!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna show you what racing is all about!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: In other words, this is a declaration of war!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I totally felt Turbo's true power! Mnh...
